articles.title: Zero-code, low-cost data ingestion: New BigQuery DTS capabilities
articles.summary: Google Cloud's BigQuery Data Transfer Service eliminates engineering burden with new capabilities. Trusted by thousands of customers every single day.
articles.detail: BigQuery Data Transfer Service (DTS) is a fully managed service that enables zero-code, low-cost data ingestion from various sources into BigQuery. With DTS, users can eliminate the engineering burden and focus on analyzing their data.

articles.title: How Google Cloud detects, contains, and protects against emerging threats
articles.summary: Google Cloud's security model is designed to detect, contain, and protect against emerging threats. The company continuously works to proactively identify and mitigate potential threats.
articles.detail: Google Cloud's security approach is based on a shared fate model, where the company empowers customers with tools, governance, and infrastructure needed to securely deploy workloads and maintain long-term trust.

articles.title: Unifying Structured and Unstructured Data Insights with BQ Search Innovations
articles.summary: Google Cloud's BigQuery introduces new search innovations to unlock insights from unstructured data, enabling customers to manage and extract value from their data.
articles.detail: BigQuery's search capabilities enable users to extract insights from unstructured data such as PDFs, audio files, images, and unstructured text, without requiring complex pipelines or disparate search infrastructure.

articles.title: GOL! How TelevisaUnivision streamed the FIFA World Cup to millions with Google Cloud
articles.summary: TelevisaUnivision successfully streamed the FIFA World Cup to millions of viewers using Google Cloud's infrastructure, showcasing the power of cloud-based live sports broadcasting.
articles.detail: Google Cloud enabled TelevisaUnivision to handle high volumes of concurrent streams and deliver low-latency video to a massive audience during the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

articles.title: Microsoft vs. Broadcom: Two AI Powerhouses, One Better Investment
articles.summary: Microsoft and Broadcom are both winning in the AI trade, but they are winning it in completely different ways, and betting on the wrong one right now carries significant risks.
articles.detail: The article compares Microsoft and Broadcom's approaches to AI and their investment potential, highlighting the differences between the two companies' strategies.

articles.title: Firebird Launches CIS Region's Largest AI Factory in Armenia
articles.summary: Firebird launches the largest AI factory in the CIS region, powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing and Dell Technologies high-performance AI infrastructure.
articles.detail: The new AI factory will provide a significant boost to the region's AI computing capabilities, leveraging Firebird's expertise in custom AI chip design and manufacturing.

articles.title: Scaling the future: Why Ethernet is the backbone of AI Supercomputing
articles.summary: AI infrastructure is shifting to Ethernet, and Cisco's programmable Silicon One enables the flexibility and scale required for next-gen AI networking.
articles.detail: Ethernet is becoming the backbone of AI supercomputing due to its ability to provide high-speed connectivity and low latency, making it an essential component of modern AI infrastructure.

articles.title: SK hynix Invests 54 Trillion Won in Yongin Y2 and Cheongju M17 to Secure Mid-to-Long-Term Production Base for AI Memory Demand
articles.summary: SK Hynix invests 54 trillion won in its Yongin and Cheongju fabs to expand production capacity for both DRAM and NAND flash memory, securing a mid-to-long-term supply base for AI memory demand.
articles.detail: The investment will enable SK Hynix to meet growing demand for AI memory and maintain its competitiveness in the market.

articles.title: Amazon's AI Story Is Bigger Than You Think. Here Are 3 Reasons Why.
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence is driving growth in more than one corner of Amazon's sprawling business, and the company's AI ambitions are bigger than many think.
articles.detail: The article highlights three reasons why Amazon's AI story is larger than expected, including its impact on e-commerce, cloud computing, and advertising.

articles.title: Red Hat Positioned as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud-Native Application Platforms
articles.summary: Red Hat has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud-Native Application Platforms, recognizing its comprehensive hybrid application platform.
articles.detail: The recognition highlights Red Hat's commitment to providing a robust and flexible platform for cloud-native applications, enabling customers to build and deploy modern workloads.

articles.title: Microsoft pours $21B into India's largest data center as cloud infrastructure race heats up
articles.summary: Microsoft invests $21 billion in India's largest data center, intensifying competition and emphasizing data sovereignty in Asia.
articles.detail: The investment will enable Microsoft to expand its cloud computing capabilities in the region and meet growing demand for digital services.

articles.title: Anthropic Builds a Chip Team as AI Demand Surges
articles.summary: Anthropic confirms it's building a custom chip team to develop bespoke silicon for Claude AI models, joining competitors like Google, OpenAI, and Meta in the race for cost-efficient AI infrastructure.
articles.detail: The new team will focus on designing custom AI chips that can efficiently handle large AI workloads, reducing costs and increasing performance.

articles.title: Corning Shares Pop on Proposed Solar Tariffs. What This Means for GLW Stock.
articles.summary: The move is expected to benefit Corning's joint venture with Japan's Shin-Etsu Handotai, boosting the company's shares and prospects.
articles.detail: The proposed solar tariffs will likely increase demand for Corning's products, driving growth and profitability for the company.

articles.title: What Are Hyperscalers? The Companies Driving The AI Infrastructure Boom
articles.summary: Discover what a hyperscaler is, which companies dominate the market, and why these cloud giants are investing billions in AI and data centers.
articles.detail: Hyperscalers are cloud computing companies that provide infrastructure and services for building and deploying large-scale AI applications, driving growth and innovation in the industry.

articles.title: iPhone 18 Pro Release Might Be Delayed Due to Memory Shortage
articles.summary: Apple faces a memory bottleneck, leaving $1 billion in TSMC chips waiting for RAM ahead of the iPhone 18 Pro and foldable iPhone Ultra release.
articles.detail: The memory shortage is expected to delay the release of Apple's new iPhones, highlighting the importance of securing reliable supply chains for critical components.
